events.title: Beach Party Foodie Friday
events.summary: Street food, craft ales and live music in Stockport Market Place.

events.title: Made in Manchester Festival
events.summary: Two-day family music festival with rides, kids’ zone, food, bars and a Sunday family dog show.

events.title: Tree Music N’Estival
events.summary: Woodland weekender mixing live music, DJs, storytelling, art and nature. Public transport is recommended because parking is very limited.

events.title: Poynton Show + monster trucks
events.cost: Advance adult £15; child 5–17 £8.50; 65+ £13; family £36 before fees
events.summary: Agricultural show with Big Pete and Grim Reaper monster trucks among the attractions.

events.title: Nevill T. Bear’s Beast & Bug Detective Trail
events.cost: £3 per child plus Hall admission; magnifying glass included
events.summary: A mini-detective spotting trail around Bramall Hall looking for bats, birds, beetles and other creatures.

events.title: Anson Engine Museum Steam Weekend
events.summary: Bank Holiday steam weekend at the Anson Engine Museum.

events.title: Chadkirk open day: chapel, jazz + bird/bat boxes
events.summary: Free open day with JD Gentle Jazz, walks and optional bird/bat-box making.
